name: TOTO
quotes: The frontline is wherever my weapon lands. Step aside.

traits.title: Frontline Duty
traits.description: A swarm of enemies is a safety violation. Built for the front line, he moves in without delay, treating any threat as something to be immediately eliminated.

traits.title: Creating Safe Zones
traits.description: His weapon is designed to push forward, break enemy lines, and force space open.

traits.title: Frontline Momentum
traits.description: Fiercely loyal and built for the frontline, Toto dashes straight into chaos. He cuts through enemies with relentless momentum.

name: PIPI
quotes: Distance means nothing when your aim is flawless.

traits.title: Still Sight, Perfect Strike
traits.description: While the battlefield turns into complete madness, Pipi calmly lines up the perfect target.

traits.title: Weapon Identity
traits.description: Each weapon shapes a distinct rhythm to her combat.

traits.title: Flawless Execution
traits.description: Once she starts dashing through the front lines, Pipi dictates the flow of the entire battlefield.

name: PITO
quotes: I do not run. I simply cease to be where danger exists.

traits.title: Calculated Erasure
traits.description: Resolves threats instantly, preferring minimal effort over prolonged engagement.

traits.title: Arcane Discipline
traits.description: Her magic is defined by precision and intellect. Condensed bursts, piercing beams, and rapid volleys each offer a distinct way to fight.

traits.title: Spatial Reallocation
traits.description: Employs teleportation not as escape, but as precise spatial reallocation to maintain ideal combat range.
